protocol:
1. Set up the bench with labeled microcentrifuge tubes in a purple tube rack, open 96-well racks, disposable pipette tips, a single-channel adjustable micropipette, an Eppendorf multichannel pipette, and a labeled agar Petri dish.

2. Fit a disposable tip onto a single-channel micropipette and position the pipette over the opened 96-well racks on the bench.

3. Aspirate liquid from a well in the pink 96-well rack using the single-channel micropipette.

4. Dispense the aspirated liquid into a labeled microcentrifuge tube held above the purple tube rack.

5. Return the microcentrifuge tube to the purple tube rack after dispensing the liquid.

6. Aspirate liquid from a well in the blue 96-well rack using the single-channel micropipette.

7. Dispense the liquid into another labeled microcentrifuge tube and mix the tube contents by pipetting up and down.

8. Repeat single-channel pipetting between the 96-well racks and labeled microcentrifuge tubes, changing tubes as needed and keeping the tubes organized in the purple rack.

9. Open the labeled agar Petri dish and hold the agar surface exposed for sample application.

10. Dispense a liquid sample from the single-channel micropipette onto the agar surface of the labeled Petri dish.

11. Touch the pipette tip to the agar surface and spread or streak the dispensed sample across a marked area of the plate.

12. Return to the microcentrifuge tubes and aspirate another liquid sample with the single-channel micropipette.

13. Apply the additional liquid sample to the agar plate with the pipette tip and spread it on the agar surface.

14. Close or set down the labeled agar Petri dish on the bench after sample application.

15. Use the single-channel micropipette to transfer liquid from the green 96-well rack into a labeled microcentrifuge tube.

16. Place the single-channel micropipette down on the bench near the other pipettes after completing the tube transfers.

17. Pick up an Eppendorf multichannel pipette and align the channels over the green 96-well rack.

18. Load disposable tips onto the multichannel pipette by pressing the channels into a row of tips in the green 96-well rack.

19. Seat the multichannel tips firmly on the pipette by pressing the pipette downward onto the tip row.

20. Check the recording device on the bench-mounted camera after the pipetting and plating steps are complete.
